Filter: rpt_charges.procedure_code IN (:procedure_codes). Legacy SELECT dual-list dialog becomes a searchable multi-select with category tree and code ranges (filter_card 12). Confirm on the live tool whether inactive codes are listed.

dynamic_rules.legacy_effect: The SELECT picker chooses office groups defined in setup instead of offices; with Office it chooses one or more offices. Cross-cutting statement of the document for the Appointment, Recall and Referral criteria screens - recorded once here (Procedural Recall Report); it applies to every report of this category that has the Office / Office Group radios.
dynamic_rules.new_behavior: office_scope: the mode radio decides which value key is set. Mode office -> office_ids (picker lists the offices the caller may read; default token working_office; my_offices and all added). Mode office_group -> office_group_id (picker lists Setup office groups; legacy default ALL = all office groups the caller may read). Exactly one key is sent; switching the mode clears the other selection. Same rule on all four recall reports (recall_reports.r02-r04 have the same radio).

dynamic_rules.legacy_when: A favorite has already been saved for the report (the legacy tool keeps one saved version per report)
dynamic_rules.legacy_effect: The action button ADD TO MY FAVORITES reads UPDATE MY FAVORITES. Cross-cutting statement of the document for the Appointment, Recall and Referral criteria screens - recorded once here (Procedural Recall Report); it applies to every report of this category. Whether the relabel shows only when the screen is opened from My Favorites is not stated.
dynamic_rules.new_behavior: Legacy one-favorite-per-report is replaced by server-side saved views: ADD TO MY FAVORITES saves a view (params with tokens, definition_version) and marks it favorite; when the caller already has a favorite view of this report_key the button reads UPDATE MY FAVORITES and overwrites that view after a confirm. Further views are allowed (enhancement). Applies to all four recall reports.

Primary date range on the date of the booked appointment that carries the recall code, not the due date (vendor documentation). Evaluated range-aware: rpt_recall_due() is called with p_scheduled_from = date_from, p_scheduled_to = date_to (RPT-RECALL-02), so scheduled_basis = 'exact' and is_scheduled are computed against the requested range, past dates included; the printed scheduled_date is masked to CASE WHEN scheduled_basis = 'exact' THEN scheduled_date END. Fixed date_basis scheduled_date (no basis radio). Default = today in the office time zone (relative token). Enhanced with presets and relative tokens.

Include on the patient's preferred provider (Patient Information; printed Pref Prdr). One patient-level value, the same on every code line of the patient: coalesce(rpt_patient_dim.preferred_provider_id, rpt_patient_activity.last_visit_provider_id) (data card 5.2 attribution rule), flagged preferred_provider_source = patient / derived; the derived value prints with the marker '*'. This deviates from the shared dictionary row of preferred_provider_ids (filter card 3.2: no fallback, migrated patients match only under all) because preferred providers were not migrated; requests: 03 (RPT-RECALL-02) to change the 2.24 per-code fallback to this per-patient column, 04 to record the derived fallback in the dictionary row. all = no predicate. Legacy SELECT dialog becomes a searchable multi-select (roster-first, never scoped by providers.office_id); dialog content never captured - confirm list source and inactive rows on the live tool.

Include on the patient's preferred hygienist (column Pref Hyg): rpt_patient_dim.preferred_hygienist_id (exposed as rpt_recall_due().preferred_hygienist_id). Not migrated and no fallback (shared dictionary rule): a narrowed selection matches only patients edited in the app and the run prints the availability entry preferred_hygienist_not_migrated; all = no predicate, patients without a hygienist kept. Picker lists hygienists first. Dialog content never captured - confirm list source and inactive rows on the live tool.

A recall counts as scheduled only when the recallable procedure code is embedded in the future appointment: the scheduled recall date is filled from that appointment, and an appointment that does not carry the code does not make the recall scheduled.

legacy_corrections.text: Include Inactive Patients is the last control of the panel: nothing lies below the row that the action bar cuts, so the criteria are complete as transcribed.
The range is applied to the recall due date: a future range lists upcoming recalls, a past range overdue ones.

Scheduled / Not Scheduled test whether a future appointment contains the recall code - a patient who is booked but whose appointment does not carry the code still lists as not scheduled. Not Scheduled is the working list.
Scheduled / Not Scheduled is evaluated per recall code: a patient with two of three codes scheduled still lists for the third.
ALL = every recallable code; the vendor advises choosing anchor codes only (for example the adult / child prophylaxis codes).
PREFERRED PROVIDER and PREFERRED HYGIENIST filter on the patient's preferred provider / hygienist.
Not Scheduled reproduces the former menu report Recall Due/Overdue but Not Scheduled Report.
